purpose: Correction latency: when this publisher corrects a figure, how long until AI systems stop serving the old one? A metric nobody publishes, because it needs a dated corrections log and a repeatable probe. Both exist here.

method: Each observation is one probe of one system on one date. Latency for a system = days from corrected_on to the first observation in which it serves the new value and no later observation serves the old one. Reported per system as a date and a day count, never averaged across systems.
